title: org.projectfile.build extension (v1)
description: Standalone contract for the value at the org.projectfile.build subtree of a projectfile document — the registry hosts and BUILD ARGUMENTS a project's container build depends on, declared ONCE and lowered to BOTH the local make plane (m6e) and a forge CI plane (the pf-ci). It carries only what `docker build` consumes: registry-host building blocks (also used at `docker login`/push) and a FLAT map of build-args, where a `FROM` image ref is just one such arg with its registry + tag interpolated in place (`${B19_DOCKER_REGISTRY}/b19/ubuntu/${B19_UBUNTU_SERIES}:${M6E_BASE_IMAGE_DEFAULT_VERSION}`). Images a TOOL RUNS IN (e.g. the container `go vet` executes inside) are NOT a build concern — they live under `org.projectfile.ci.images`, referenced by `org.projectfile.ci.tools.<t>.image`. Every key is a VARIABLE NAME and every value is an expression over OTHER such variables (`${NAME}`); no key names a registry host, a forge, or a CI engine — a generator substitutes its own spelling (m6e `$(NAME)` + `export NAME ?= …`; GitHub/Forgejo `${{ vars.NAME }}`).

registries.description: Registry-host building blocks every image var composes against — a map of VAR NAME -> default value. The default SHOULD be a LOUD unresolvable sentinel (`registry.invalid`) so a misconfigured workspace fails VISIBLY rather than silently pulling a wrong image; the real value comes from the environment / forge `vars.<NAME>`, the single source of truth shared across planes. Each namespace declares its own (a b19 fragment declares B19_DOCKER_REGISTRY).

args.description: Build arguments delivered into the container build — a map of NAME -> a value rule. A bare scalar (string, number, or boolean) is shorthand for {default: value}, coerced to its literal string form so `B19_GCC_SERIES: 16` and `B19_GCC_SERIES: "16"` lower identically. The object form is needed only for `file:` (a build-time path read) or when the explicit `default:` key improves readability.

env.description: Process environment variable NAMES forwarded into the build and the tool runs when set — names only, never values (no secrets). The build-time analogue of a tool manifest's `env:`; the canonical case is a private package proxy a module-resolving build step honours (GOPROXY). Lowered as a forward-if-set `--build-arg` (m6e) / step `env` (forge).

mounts.description: Build-time bind/cache mounts the container build backend binds while building the image — a list of {from, to}. The same unified mount model a tool manifest's `mounts` uses, applied to the BUILD step: package-manager caches and regenerable volumes a buildah/buildx backend mounts into the build context (so a cache must NOT be baked into the immutable image, 12-factor). `to` is the absolute container mountpoint; `from` discriminates the lowering: a bare NAME (no `/`) is a regenerable managed volume (m6e binds $(XDG_CACHE_HOME)/<from>); a real PATH (~/…, ./…, /…) is a host bind bound verbatim (m6e-only — a forge build on an ephemeral runner has no such host path and ignores it). Absent => no build mounts (the common case).

arg.description: A build-argument value rule. Either a bare scalar (string, number, or boolean — shorthand for {default: value}, coerced to its literal string so an author need not quote `16`) or an object with exactly one of `default` or `file`. `default` is a literal scalar value always forwarded (coerced to its literal string form), or the empty string (NO default — forwarded only when the variable is set in the environment, so an undefined var never clobbers a working Dockerfile default with an empty string). `file` names a path whose CONTENT becomes the arg value at build time (a runtime read-step, for a per-cell digest pin); the path MAY embed `{<axis>}` matrix placeholders substituted per cell. A composition-only tag belongs in `versions`, not here — args are forwarded as build arguments, version vars are not.

oneOf.description: Shorthand for {default: value}: a scalar coerced to its literal string form (a string verbatim; a number as written, so `16`→"16"; a boolean as "true"/"false"), or "" for forward-if-set.

default.description: Literal scalar value coerced to its literal string form (a string verbatim; a number as written; a boolean as "true"/"false"), or "" for forward-if-set.

file.description: Path whose content is the arg value at build time; MAY embed `{<axis>}` matrix placeholders.

mount.description: One build-time mount: a source (`from`) bound at an absolute container mountpoint (`to`). The same {from, to} model a tool manifest's `mounts` entries use.

from.description: The mount source: a bare NAME (a managed volume/cache, bound under $(XDG_CACHE_HOME) on m6e) or a real host PATH (~/…, ./…, /…; bound verbatim, m6e-only).

to.description: The absolute CONTAINER mountpoint the source is bound at.
